description: Creates an isolated spendctl sandbox and returns its sandbox_id. Call it first: every other tool needs the sandbox_id, and one sandbox serves a whole conversation (create another only to try a different preset). The sandbox is a real spendctl sidecar with a throwaway wallet, a mock x402 facilitator and two mock paid APIs; no real money moves and nothing outside the sandbox is reachable. Returns the sandbox_id, the agent's policy (budgets, allowed hosts, approval rule) and the paid endpoints with their prices. Limits: 5 sandboxes per minute per client; a sandbox expires after 2 hours without calls (24 hours at most). Example: preset "strict" to see refusals, "approvals" to see a payment held for a human.

preset.description: Policy preset. default: comfortable caps, both endpoints allowed; strict: $0.015 per request and $0.03 per day, weather only, so the search API and a fourth weather call are refused; approvals: payments at or above $0.015 wait for approve
